A bounding box extent includes both bounding voxels, so along each axis it equals the difference between the two bounds plus 1. The axial axis is axis 2 of the sampling grid. Voxel indices count from 0, and each one lies inside the bounding box it is reported for. If several slices tie, report the one with the lowest index.
